optimizedDescription.value: Global ChangeRepository port: bucketed change storage, serialized mutation, drift invalidation, indexes, and confined artifact I/O.

optimizedContext.value:
# ChangeRepository Port

## Rules
- `ChangeRepository` abstract class extends `Repository`; inherited `workspace()`, `ownership()`, `isExternal()` default-only. Application-facing listed storage ops abstract; internal manifest writer excluded.
- Storage global: active `changes/`, drafted `drafts/`, discarded `discarded/`. `get` active-only → `Change|null`; default omitted artifact/file `state` to `missing`. `getDraft`/`getDiscarded` bucket-only → `DraftedChangeView`/`DiscardedChangeView|null`; no writes/drift invalidation. Discarded view via `toDiscardedChangeView`.
- `get()` snapshot only; never caller RMW primitive. It may locked auto-invalidate active drift; coordinated updates MUST use `mutate(name, fn)`.
- `mutate(name, fn)`: active-only, per-name exclusive window covers fresh load, callback, manifest write, post-save reconcile; reload via non-writing/non-locking internal path; callback gets `isDrafted === false`; success persists then returns `{ result, change }` (post-reconcile); missing/draft-only → `ChangeNotFoundError`; callback throw: unlock, no partial persistence. Different names MAY concurrent.
- `mutateDraft(name, fn)`: drafted-only, fresh `isDrafted === true`; only `RestoreChange`, `DiscardChange`, internals use in production; success persists/moves `drafts/` ↔ `changes/` or → `discarded/`, post-bucket reconcile, returns `{ result, change }`; missing active/discarded → `ChangeNotFoundError`; failed callback no partial persistence.
- `FsChangeRepository.get()` with resolved artifact types: compare cleaned hash vs prior SHA-256 `validatedHash`. Shared internal read path for load/status/lock drift handling. On drift: lock `_withChangeLock`, reload, collect ALL mismatches grouped artifact type, mark `drifted-pending-review`, recompute aggregate states, domain-invalidate to `designing` (remaining files `pending-review`), atomic persist. Applies all lifecycles; history has `cause: "artifact-drift"`, message, full `affectedArtifacts`; actor `SYSTEM_ACTOR`. Uninitialized artifact types bypass.
- `list` active `ActiveChangeListEntry`, `createdAt` asc; `listDrafts` `DraftedChangeListEntry`, `draftedAt` desc; `listDiscarded` `DiscardedChangeListEntry`, `discardedAt` desc. Lightweight only (no aggregates/content/history); detail via `get*`. `include*` projects cached optional fields only; no extra reads.
- `count`/`countDrafts`/`countDiscarded` efficient, same index totals as list. `reindex`, `reindexActive`, `reindexDrafts`, `reindexDiscarded` force relevant `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/` rebuild; callers never know JSONL layout.
- `create(change)`: new across all buckets only; atomically create dir+manifest, never artifact bytes; duplicate → `ChangeAlreadyExistsError` or equivalent. Existing manifests persist only inside `mutate`/`mutateDraft`/locked `get` internals; drafted write outside allowed mutation window → `DraftedChangeReadOnlyError`. `delete` removes whole dir.
- `artifact(change, filename)`: tracked artifact files only; return `SpecArtifact|null`, loaded `originalHash` = disk-content SHA-256. Artifact reads/existence and related lookup MUST be confined to change dir; reject traversal/alternate encodings/untracked files. SHOULD debug-log resolution/rejection per global logging.
- `saveArtifact(change, artifact, options?)`: active same-name `mutate`/`mutateDraft` window required before any write; drafted outside it → `DraftedChangeReadOnlyError`. `originalHash` mismatch → `ArtifactConflictError`; `{ force: true }` skips check. Writes bytes only; MUST NOT mutate in-memory `Change` status/hashes/history/approvals; returns `void`. `artifactExists`/`deltaExists`: presence only.
- `changePath` absolute active path; `draftChangePath` absolute `drafts/` path. `internalPaths()` → absolute owned paths or `undefined` (never empty for N/A); Fs returns changes/drafts/discarded.
- `scaffold(change, specExists)` creates spec artifact `specs/<ws>/<capPath>/` or `deltas/<ws>/<capPath>/`; change-scope uses existing root. `unscaffold(change, specIds)` recursively deletes both per-spec dirs, idempotently.

## Constraints
- Inherited workspace context unused.
- List default no limit: full bucket; `meta.limit === meta.total`.
- New changes use `create`; existing only `mutate`/`mutateDraft`.
- `saveArtifact` byte writes separate from manifest/reconcile state.
- `ArtifactConflictError` sole artifact-byte concurrency error; force bypasses.
- Manifest writes atomic.
- Durable mutation aggregate is returned `.change`, not callback object.
